scope: Track a retired subscription setup (and the idle/drain work it hands over on completion) in pendingDrainRef at effect cleanup, so teardownForReplace awaits it.
files_to_modify: app/src/lib/marmot/replaceTeardown.ts (helper: trackRetiredSetup(pending, groupId, setup, handedOver) = trackPending(setup.then(() => Promise.all(handedOver()))))
app/src/context/MarmotContext.tsx (per-run lifecycle list; the retired path records idle/drain promises; cleanup calls the helper for each run lifecycle)

behavior.tracked: After an effect cleanup, pendingDrainRef for the group holds a promise that settles only after the retired setup AND the idle/drain work it handed over settle.
behavior.late_handover: Idle work registered when the retired setup finishes (after a replace snapshotted pending) is still awaited by that replace.

tests: Unit replaceTeardown: retired setup + late idle blocks teardown until settled; never-settling late idle makes teardown throw; settled work is dropped from pending
